Source snapshot: Apple Inc. 2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm
Filing date: 2025-10-31
Period of report: 2025-09-27

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says the company has a large global business and a significant majority of manufacturing is performed by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says restrictive measures can increase costs, limit product or component availability, require supplier changes, and affect product distribution.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Apple had outstanding fixed-rate notes with an aggregate principal amount of $91.3 billion, with $12.4 billion payable within 12 months.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Apple had manufacturing purchase obligations of $56.2 billion, with $55.4 billion payable within 12 months.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says future gross margins can be impacted by industry-wide product pricing pressures, increased competition, supply shortages, tariffs, and macroeconomic pressure.
